label: G F41#3 recheck Capacitor Alpha
brief: Fixed captures from the game of one catalogue subject in the stormwood biome: named wild fight actor spacing (Capacitor Alpha fight; frames in reading order are timed frames and the enemy's telegraphed attack from start to impact). Judge how this subject looks in the game - whether it reads as the key art's world, with believable form, material, light and staging. Score the subject, not the rest of the frame.
defects: Voltarach and Sparkit crowd into the same space so the boss legs mask or intersect the ally and sometimes the trainer
